reproduction.rationale: Matched assistance is declared in access-conditions.v1.json, but authentic common/code manifests, evaluation identity, runtime/exposure and finite budgets are not yet frozen. Bind publication-equivalent processed response inputs and the exact 79-electrode/four-participant/area roster, resolving the 17/15 caption reversal without selecting a favorable area assignment. Resolve source positional CV columns2:821 versus named response0..818 and active P/category-selective versus Figure3 none/S/responsive callers against result-producing evidence. Corrected columns are a separate branch until parity is justified. Authenticate historical 12-fold/72-condition assignments or qualify the exact source stochastic recipe with logged folds, paired candidate/author exposure and justified published-result calibration; preserve66 train/six query conditions with one query per category. Recover complete native DN and DN(S) Figure3C reference outputs, original runtime/numerical parity including scalar-SSE least_squares objective, source rounding and source region reduction. No authentic fits have been run by this construction. Specify full-region superiority and participant/electrode dependence, meaningful effect and reproduction tolerance; freeze common artifacts, exact author-code package, finite episode/search/resource limits and protected final scoring. The selected source endpoint retains a complete metric array without an authenticated original scalar reduction. Existing improvement/v1 scalar admission cannot qualify this full-panel comparison; an additive full-panel comparator/admission engine and reviewed complete-support criterion remain required. No new mean, win count or convenient scalar is substituted.
